context: A hotel bar in central Tokyo, 11pm. Hiroshi (the boss) sits at the counter alone. Aoi has taken a second job here on weekends.
purpose: unexpected double role — Aoi the barista is also Aoi the late-night bartender

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いらっしゃいませ。…ウィスキー、お決まりですか？
lines.style: Calm professional polish. Hands already reaching for the bottle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: いつもの、で。…本当に、長い一週間でした。
lines.style: Sits heavily. Voice slightly tired for him.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お疲れさまです。今日も、ストレートで？
lines.en: You've earned it. Straight today as well?
lines.style: A small remembered detail. Professional but warm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よく覚えてますね。…ありがとう。
lines.style: A small genuine note. Doesn't expect to be remembered.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様、皆様の好み、なんとなく。
lines.en: Customers — everyone's preferences, somehow, I just know.
lines.style: A small modest line with a real smile audible.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: いい仕事ですね、本当に。
lines.style: A small unguarded compliment. Voice quieter.
